title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00096 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:00: Continued rigging up handling equipment for pulling tubing
01:00 - 01:30: Performed TBT for pulling tubing
01:30 - 01:45: P/u and m/u tubing hanger retrieval tool
01:45 - 02:15: RIH with th retrieval tool to 20m to build landing string
02:15 - 02:30: Pulled out and installed control lines to th retrieval tool
02:30 - 02:45: RIH with th retrieval tool and landed out in th at 21. 1m. Locked in and confirmed 5 ton overpull
02:45 - 04:30: Attempted to engage threads on th retrieval tool to communication collar. Re-attempted several times.
04:30 - 05:30: Evaluated situation.
05:30 - 06:30: Attempted to pull tubing. Pulled with 90 ton OP, th retrieval tool pulled free from th. POOH with th retrieval tool.
06:30 - 07:00: L/d down tubing hanger and running tool. Inspected same, no damages.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT to move casing tong to set back area
07:15 - 08:45: Moved casing tong from well center to set back area. Changed elevator inserts from 7" to 5 1/2" meanwhile installed rotator. Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
08:45 - 09:30: Prepared to p/u spear BHA. Waited on deck crew to handle helicopter prior to pick up spear. L/o 2 ea 5 1/2" DP singles on cantilever and measured same.
09:30 - 11:00: P/u and m/u spear BHA. RIH from surface to 14m. P/u 2 ea 5 1/2" DP singles from cantilever. M/u double in foxhole. M/u double to spear BHA.
11:00 - 12:15: RIH with spear assy. Took up/down weight 69/66 ton. Made several attempts to pass th at 20,7m. Rotated string w/ 5rpm/3knm. Spear assy passed through restriction. Continued RIH to 26m. Engaged spear and p/u to 10t overpull. P/u 1,7m, 92 ton overpull tubing weight).
12:15 - 13:15: Indication of small pressure increase on a-annulus. Performed extended flow check on trip tank, static.
13:15 - 13:45: POOH with th and set slips
13:45 - 14:15: B/o double from TDS and released spear.
14:15 - 15:00: R/u casing tong
15:00 - 15:45: B/o and l/d 7" th. R/b spear assy in set-back.
15:45 - 17:15: Droppe

Attempted to engage threads on th retrieval tool to communication collar. Re-attempted several times.
Evaluated situation.
Attempted to pull tubing. Pulled with 90 ton OP, th retrieval tool pulled free from th. POOH with th retrieval tool.
L/d down tubing hanger and running tool. Inspected same, no damages.
Performed TBT to move casing tong to set back area
Moved casing tong from well center to set back area. Changed elevator inserts from 7" to 5 1/2" meanwhile installed rotator. Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Prepared to p/u spear BHA. Waited on deck crew to handle helicopter prior to pick up spear. L/o 2 ea 5 1/2" DP singles on cantilever and measured same.
P/u and m/u spear BHA. RIH from surface to 14m. P/u 2 ea 5 1/2" DP singles from cantilever. M/u double in foxhole. M/u double to spear BHA.

RIH with spear assy. Took up/down weight 69/66 ton. Made several attempts to pass th at 20,7m. Rotated string w/ 5rpm/3knm. Spear assy passed through restriction. Continued RIH to 26m. Engaged spear and p/u to 10t overpull. P/u 1,7m, 92 ton overpull tubing weight).
Indication of small pressure increase on a-annulus. Performed extended flow check on trip tank, static.
POOH with th and set slips
B/o double from TDS and released spear.
R/u casing tong
B/o and l/d 7" th. R/b spear assy in set-back.
Dropped 2" ball and m/u 7" pump-in sub. Installed cement hose. Applied 20 bar from cement unit and verified line-up. Pressured up string and opened me plug at 47 bar. R/d pump-in sub and cement hose.
Tested compact spider.
POOH from 2380m to 2367m. Removed master bushings and installed weatherford spider slips and centralizers.
Attempted to break connection. Chenged master dies on casing tong.
Performed TBT prior to pull tubing. Checked all lifting equipment.
L/o 1 joint and 1 pup. Attached control line to spooling unit.
POOH with 5 STD 7" tubing from 2367 mmd to 2187 mmd, r/b stands. Performed LRA measurements every 3 STD.
POOH and l/o 2 singles and joint with me plug.
POOH with 6 STD 7" tubing from 2152 mmd to 1939 mmd, r/b stands. Performed LRA measurements every 3 STD.
POOH and l/o 2 joints prior to l/d DHSV assy.
